_note: Forwarded slot props follow svelte2tsx's slot resolver. A component's own `let:` names, and those of its direct children that name a slot, resolve at value level to `__sveltets_2_instanceOf(Comp).$$slot_def['slot'].name` (a destructured leaf through `((PATTERN) => leaf)(...)`) for any component, dotted names included, and to `any` under `<svelte:component>`. Only plain identifiers directly inside the destructure are resolved; nested patterns, defaults, each indexes, snippet parameters, `{@const}` names and `let:` on plain elements keep their names as written. A `let:` on an element outside any component is an ordinary attribute (TS2353) that declares nothing (TS18004), and an object spread in a resolved `let:` makes svelte2tsx throw, dropping the file (Spread.svelte).
